description:
Modelled 0-100 score for how hot each suburb's house and unit market is against the rest of its state, monthly for the last two years, with the four parts behind the latest score. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: About 4,300 suburbs have a house score and 1,700 a unit score in at least one of the last 24 months (about 2,300 and 800 in the latest month); suburbs with fewer than 10 sales of that type in the latest 3 months, and states with fewer than 30 such suburbs, are not scored. Monthly, November 2024 to October 2026. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/suburb-hotness`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: hotness_house, hotness_unit, price_momentum_house, sales_volume_change_house, rent_growth_house, rent_vs_price_house, price_momentum_unit, sales_volume_change_unit, rent_growth_unit, rent_vs_price_unit. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_market_suburb_hotness
title: Suburb hotness index
